headline: Life Insurance Corporation of India: Post-OFS Shareholding Pattern Update
sum: LIC files post-OFS shareholding pattern disclosure with NSE, signalling completion or material progress in its Offer For Sale tranche and consequent changes to share capital structure.
implication: Post-OFS filings trigger mandatory shareholding pattern disclosures under Listing Rules; the timing and granularity of such filings signal the precise closing date and final public float for secondary market compliance and institutional ownership tracking.
detail: Life Insurance Corporation of India notified the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) of its updated shareholding pattern following an Offer For Sale (OFS) transaction. The disclosure, filed as a regulatory update under SEBI Listing Regulations, captures the post-transaction distribution of shares among the Government of India, LIC's promoter entities, public shareholders and other stakeholders. This filing is mandatory under Regulation 31(1)(b) of the SEBI Listing Regulations and signals the completion or near-completion of the OFS process.
